domain: Dam water level control system with automatic pump shutdown.

glossary.definition: Ordered procedure for stopping active pumps, consisting of a ramp-down phase followed by a hard stop command issued to each pump controller.

business_rules.rule: On receiving a shutdown command, each pump must complete its ramp-down phase within 2 seconds and must not be restarted for a minimum hold-off period of 60 seconds after the hard stop.
